note: Three ways to be each Role at the Skills step, for a player who has never opened the book. A preset is not a new rule and grants nothing: it names the Skills a way of working leans on, and engine/skillPresets.ts turns that into an ordinary allocation that the printed validators accept for Edgerunner and Complete Package alike (every Role Skill kept at the floor or above, focus Skills raised to the cap first, support Skills next, the budget spent exactly). Every name must be one of that Role's printed twenty Skills; a test holds each preset to legality. The house rule is only that these three are the ones offered.

rockerboy.name: The Headliner
rockerboy.pitch: The crowd came for you. Every room is a stage and you know exactly where the light is.

rockerboy.name: The Street Poet
rockerboy.pitch: You know every block, and every block knows your words. The song is a map and a warning.

rockerboy.name: The Riot
rockerboy.pitch: The show ends when the fight does. You play loud and you hit harder.

solo.name: The Gunslinger
solo.pitch: Fast hands, faster eyes. You are already moving when they reach for iron.

solo.name: The Bodyguard
solo.pitch: Somebody is paying you to stand in the doorway. Nobody gets through it.

solo.name: The Blade
solo.pitch: Quiet, close and over before the alarm. You prefer it personal.

netrunner.name: The Ghost
netrunner.pitch: In, out, and nobody ever knew. Locks and cameras are just questions you already answered.

netrunner.name: The Archivist
netrunner.pitch: Every secret leaves a record. You are the one who finds it and reads it first.

netrunner.name: The Tinkerer
netrunner.pitch: Chrome, code and a soldering iron. If it has a port, it can be taught new tricks.

tech.name: The Bench Genius
tech.pitch: Give you a week and a pile of scrap and you will hand back something the corps would kill for.

tech.name: The Gearhead
tech.pitch: Engines, rigs, anything with wheels. You keep the crew moving and you drive it home.

tech.name: The Breaker
tech.pitch: Doors, panels, alarms. What the building says no to, you talk out of it.

medtech.name: The Trauma Surgeon
medtech.pitch: Bring them in bleeding and they walk out. Your hands are steadier than anybody's nerves.

medtech.name: The Field Medic
medtech.pitch: You patch people up under fire, and you shoot back while you do it.

medtech.name: The Diagnostician
medtech.pitch: Symptoms, lies and wounds all tell a story. You read them before anybody speaks.

media.name: The Investigator
media.pitch: Follow the money, the lies and the missing hour. The story is always under the story.

media.name: The Face
media.pitch: Everyone talks to you. A smile, a favour, a drink, and the quote is yours.

media.name: The Stringer
media.pitch: You get the shot nobody else got, from somewhere nobody else would stand.

exec.name: The Dealmaker
exec.pitch: Every meeting is a negotiation and you have never walked out of one poorer.

exec.name: The Operator
exec.pitch: You know where the paper goes and who signs it. Systems bend when you lean on them.

exec.name: The Shark
exec.pitch: You read the room, you read the lips, and you keep a pistol in the briefcase.

lawman.name: The Detective
lawman.pitch: Every crime scene talks. You listen longer than the people who made it.

lawman.name: The Enforcer
lawman.pitch: When the badge is not enough, you are. You go through the door first.

lawman.name: The Tracker
lawman.pitch: Nobody runs far enough. You find the trail, and you follow it to the end.

fixer.name: The Broker
fixer.pitch: You know what everybody wants and who has it. Your cut is the whole point.

fixer.name: The Street Fixer
fixer.pitch: Every corner owes you a favour. The neighbourhood is your office and your armour.

fixer.name: The Forger
fixer.pitch: Papers, locks and quiet exits. You make the impossible look like it was always allowed.

nomad.name: The Road Warrior
nomad.pitch: Foot down, gun out, family in the back. You get everyone through.

nomad.name: The Scout
nomad.pitch: You go ahead of the convoy and come back with what is waiting. Nobody sees you do it.

nomad.name: The Trader
nomad.pitch: Every town on the road buys something and sells something. You know both prices.
